errors.message: line 3: write a pulse as "pulse cc1 for 200 ms".
line 4: dmx1 cannot pulse. Pulses work on out1 to out4, rly1, rly2, cc1 and cc2.
line 5: rly1 is a relay or a contact: pulse it for at least 0.1 s.
line 6: there is no out9 on this board. The outputs are out1 to out4, rly1, rly2, cc1 and cc2.
line 7: "soon" is not a time. Write seconds (wait 2.5) or add a unit: ms, s or min.
line 8: runs_per_cooldown is a number of runs, not a time.
line 9: cc1 is set to pulse on every trigger (cc1_role). Set cc1_role to shows to use it in a script.
